_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor from Komga's documentation; no upstream egg.
name: Komga
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Komga is a media server for comics, manga, magazines and eBooks, with a web reader and OPDS for reading apps. The egg runs it with SQLite: open its address to create the admin account, and upload your books to the library folder.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Komga: downloads Komga's jar from its GitHub releases, checked against
# GitHub's SHA-256. The database, settings and your comics (config, and
# any folder you upload) are never touched, and the jar is only replaced
# once the new one is complete.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

# gh-release says why when the release doesn't exist or GitHub can't be reached.
tag=$(gh-release tag gotson/komga "${VERSION:-latest}") || exit 1

if [ -f komga.jar ] && [ "$(cat .komga-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "Komga $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Komga $tag"
    gh-release download gotson/komga "$tag" "komga-$tag.jar" komga.jar.new
    mv -f komga.jar.new komga.jar
    echo "$tag" > .komga-version
fi
mkdir -p config library
echo "Installed Komga $tag. Open the server's address to create the admin account, then add the library folder."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Komga version to install, such as 1.30.1, or latest. Reinstall to change it.
